notes.title: Update for new Ghost data
notes.content: Added new Ghosts reflecting the playing style of players.

notes.title: Join the second BETA round now!
notes.content:
We just finished the first round of beta testing for the new HYPER Edition features and we are already rolling into the second round.

The focus this time will be the [b]new campaign mode[/b]!

Head over to our discord for further details and to sign up for it. https://discord.gg/7Nr8Ebx

notes.title: To the HYPER-Future and Beyond!
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce that finally Lightfield is coming to Steam! But it's not just a straight port of the console version. Over the last few months we listened to a lot of feedback, took a step back to get a new perspective on it and went through all the lists of things we wanted to implement but did not have the time to for the initial release.

The [b]HYPER Edition[/b] has a couple additions, improvements, tweaks and bug fixes that will make the experience all the more futuristic.

The game will be out soon'ish but in the meantime you can join our Discord server where we will also recruit beta testers for the game! [url]https://discord.gg/u5Xjw3m[/url]
